summary: Skratch presents his full lineup of 5 teams for Week 3 of the Continental Challenge in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. He covers team builds, positioning, artifacts, gear sets, and exact skill timing for bosses including Talethia, Whisk, Elecebre, Durem, and Iola. The guide details how to reach top damage rankings using optimized setups such as Thunder CC, Necrosis, Ice Blast, Toxic Enlightenment, and Dauntless control-mitigation teams, while highlighting hero alternatives for players lacking specific legendaries.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Deals massive damage in the Thunder CC lineup when timed with Journ's energy boosts.

heroes.name: Journ
heroes.note: Requires careful positioning to distribute ultimate energy to all four teammates.

heroes.name: Fathomdown
heroes.note: Uses Misty Conch artifact along with Skill Haste and Accuracy to land crucial debuffs.

heroes.name: Saverio
heroes.note: Built with high Enlightenment and Attack to deal top necrotic damage.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Outperforms Serpentemis as main damage dealer in Toxic setups when stacked with Enlightenment and Attack.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Applies decrease accuracy and recharge speed penalty to protect the Dauntless team from boss stuns.

heroes.name: Selva
heroes.note: Uses ultimate skill to extend critical debuffs like Maashtur's accuracy reduction.

heroes.name: Stanguem
heroes.note: Provides Control Immunity to keep teams alive against Iola's stun mechanics.

heroes.name: Irma
heroes.note: Brings Control Immunity and 30% damage reduction for budget Dauntless setups.

heroes.name: Lydia
heroes.note: Grants Control Immunity to all allies via her ultimate skill.

teams.note: Thunder CC composition relying on Journ for team-wide energy generation and strict skill timing.
Necrosis team featuring Fathomdown on Misty Conch and Daphne in Attack Speed gear to maximize damage.
Ice Blast team timed to cast defensive and offensive ultimates right before the boss acts.
Toxic team with Lothair as main DPS and high overall team Skill Haste tuned to a 17.5s recast cycle.
High-resistance Dauntless team relying on Maashtur accuracy debuff extended by Selva to avoid stuns.

tips: Position Journ strategically in the Talethia team to ensure his ultimate energy buff reaches every ally.
Equip Fathomdown with Misty Conch, Skill Haste, and Accuracy to consistently apply defense penalty vs Whisk.
Against Iola, build at least 175 Resistance on all team members to resist boss crowd control effects.
Combine Maashtur's decrease accuracy debuff with Selva's ultimate debuff extension to prevent Iola from stunning your team.
If missing Maashtur or Selva against Iola, use Control Immunity heroes like Stanguem, Irma, or Lydia as budget substitutes.
title: MY 6 TEAMS & Strategy For Week 3! Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
